items.information: **Please note, this competition only has FMC and FTO!** **Competitor limit is 30 per event, meaning 60 is only the theoretical maximum competitor limit. items.name: Imagination Station A 2027

venue.name: [Imagination Station](https://www.imaginationstationtoledo.org/)
venue.details: Exploration Center - on the lower floor next to the cafeteria

items.information: This competition is at the Imagination Station science center. Non-competing family members and spectators are **required to purchase general admission** to the science center to enter the competition. Competitors will pick up their lanyards at the front desk and will not need to purchase general admission. Imagination Station opens at 10am - you will not be able to get in earlier. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbWlIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8843e254b05ca879fa0ab066c46e77b7920e76c8/Cubing%20Frontiers%20LLC%20Banner%20Transparent.png)

items.name: Kublördag Jönköping XIV - 2027

venue.name: Per Brahegymnasiet
venue.details: Tävlingen hålls i matsalen, som är en separat byggnad (Brunnsgatan 3). Alltså inte ingång genom skolans huvudentré.

items.information: Välkomna till Kublördag Jönköping! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Kublördag Jönköping! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: Odivelas FTO Rumble 2027

venue.name: Escritório DataLab
venue.address: Av. Reinaldo dos Santos 13 LJ esq, 2675-673 Odivelas

items.information: ### Espetadores só são permitidos como acompanhantes de competidores. Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OdivelasFTORumble2027#77333-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OdivelasFTORumble2027#77334-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 15%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OdivelasFTORumble2027#77337-associados-aps-aps-associates). • ### Spectators are only permitted as companions of competitors. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OdivelasFTORumble2027#77333-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OdivelasFTORumble2027#77334-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 15% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OdivelasFTORumble2027#77337-associados-aps-aps-associates). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk0NjcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f66084c35810935560dcf25769c53ea0c79d5a76/odivelas_fto_rumble_logo.png)

items.name: Uppsala FTOpen 2027
items.information: Varmt välkomna till Uppsala FTOpen 2027, den första tävlingen i Sverige där grenen FTO hålls officiellt! **OBS:** Maximalt en gäst / medföljande per deltagare på grund av tävlingslokalens storlek. Ingen utomstående publik tillåten. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. -- A warm welcome to Uppsala FTOpen 2027, the first competition in Sweden where the event FTO is held officially! **N.B.:** Maximum one guest / accompanying person per competitors due to the size of the competition venue. No external visitors allowed. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)
